description: Commission of Elections - Appointed Returning Officer of Local Authories to the Administrative Districts, Colombo, Gampaha.... etc.
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with the appointment of Returning Officers and Assistant Returning Officers for administrative districts under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It is directly related to electoral processes and the administration of elections, falling clearly under the Elections category (Type 7) as it involves electoral commission appointments and decisions for conducting local authority elections.
